speaker: Baby Momma
text: Everybody who came up here for a picture, go downstairs. Everybody who came back from the dead, remain available.

speaker: Snitch
text: I can leave one phone as a courtesy—

speaker: Wifey
text: You can leave a shoe if you don't move.

speaker: Ganger Red
text: Original recorder. Original message. I kept it.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: You also kept your mouth shut. Press play before I start grading the collection.

speaker: Cracked Head
text: Red. You said the baby's here. Tell her I heard you. Tell her I'm alive. Tell her I'll call when I can.
delivery: archival recording; same voice, narrow speaker sound

speaker: Baby Momma
text: That is your voice. Three weeks after the memorial. Our baby was nine days old.

speaker: Cracked Head
text: I know what it sounds like.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: It sounds like a man who knew he was a father. Which part needs remixing?

speaker: Ganger Blue
text: Red. You had this while we were checking on her?

speaker: Ganger Red
text: Yes.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: You watched me say thank you. Over and over. Like you was a damn guardian angel with a rewards program.

speaker: Ganger Red
text: The groceries came from him. Some of the money did too.

speaker: Cracked Head
text: I told him to tell you.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: And when my number didn't call you back, did you assume I was busy for FOUR YEARS?

speaker: Wifey
text: She asked you a question.

speaker: Cracked Head
text: No. I should have found another way.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: Good. A full sentence with a responsible adult in it.

speaker: Ganger Red
text: There's more to why I kept it.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: Then tomorrow you can explain the rest. I'm going home to the person who actually waited up for me.

speaker: Ganger Blue
text: NO FAMILY QUESTIONS? What is this, a tournament or a witness stand with chicken?

speaker: Ganger Red
text: The event was booked before last night.

speaker: Cornball
text: And I already bought six gallons of cheese. Whatever happens, we need attendance.

speaker: Ganger Red
text: Six tables. Clear the Gauntlet, you host the next neighborhood showcase. Open entry stays open.

speaker: Ganger Blue
text: Look at you announcing rules like you ain't been hiding a whole season in your notebook.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: Blue. Go find a task. You circling this table like accountability only got one address.

speaker: Ganger Red
text: I'm first. Middle district closes in round three, both sides. The canopy crew needs the space.

speaker: Cornball
text: They said they needed the space from eight this morning. Red said wait till he looks difficult.

speaker: Ganger Red
text: Put your deck down. Somebody here is still going to finish what they started.

speaker: Ganger Red
text: First table cleared. Your Crown was not a fluke.

speaker: Ganger Blue
text: Write that on the banner. Use the expensive marker.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: After the next two tables, you're coming to the back room. No phones.

speaker: Ganger Red
text: I'll be there.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: You been a lot of places you should've been talking. Try doing both.

speaker: Cornball
text: Next table's mine. Keep your wristband. The cheese has terms.

speaker: Ganger Red
text: Round three. Middle district. I put it on a sign and everything.

speaker: Cornball
text: Welcome to Cornball's Liquid Gold. Basic gets chips. Premium gets eye contact.

speaker: Wifey
text: Why does your cheese have a cancellation policy?

speaker: Cornball
text: Recurring revenue. Snitch said think bigger.

speaker: Wifey
text: You put a subscription on a dairy product.

speaker: Cornball
text: Don't reduce my company to its ingredients.

speaker: Ganger Blue
text: I'm not paying nine dollars to unlock a ladle.

speaker: Cornball
text: The ladle is infrastructure. The vision is free.

speaker: Wifey
text: The card match is free too. Before you try to bundle it.

speaker: Cornball
text: Table two. I move cards around. Pay attention. Unlike the people who ignored my sauce survey.

speaker: Cornball
text: Okay. I lost the match. The company remains confident.

speaker: Wifey
text: Your company has formed a skin.

speaker: Cornball
text: That's the protective layer. Premium customers get underneath it.

speaker: Ganger Blue
text: Why the hell is the dispenser breathing?

speaker: Cornball
text: Because the cheese is alive with opportunity.

speaker: Wifey
text: Unplug it. Stamp their card. In that order.

speaker: Cornball
text: Second table cleared. Don't put my loss on the business page.

speaker: Cornball
text: That's a loss. Rematch is free. Emotional recovery is on the deluxe menu.

speaker: Snitch
text: Welcome back. Last night a dead man made the finals. Today we're asking the difficult questions.

speaker: Wifey
text: First question. Why are you selling seats facing a closed door?

speaker: Snitch
text: Anticipation package. Premium gets to hear a chair scrape.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: You heard what I said about my business being an entrance.

speaker: Snitch
text: I ain't even got the recording. I'm covering the cultural impact.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: Cover that sign before I turn your cultural impact into a folding-table situation.

speaker: Snitch
text: Fine. Sports. We are doing sports.

speaker: Snitch
text: Table three. Little boost in round three, another in five. Growth strategy.

speaker: Wifey
text: One extra Motion each time. Two boosts. Zero mystique.

speaker: Snitch
text: Third table cleared. This footage may require some color correction.

speaker: Wifey
text: The color is you losing.

speaker: Ganger Red
text: Stop pointing a camera at that door. I knew he was alive. She didn't. That's all you're getting from me out here.

speaker: Snitch
text: Red. Say that first bit again, facing the light.

speaker: Ganger Red
text: No. Keep the sentence together.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: Come on, Red. You got a room full of consequences waiting.

speaker: Snitch
text: People are asking if you meant to do that. Come back and give me a different ending.

speaker: Church Auntie
text: Sit down. I brought plates because this family cannot digest a fact on an empty stomach.

speaker: All Jokes Roaster
text: Red, you sweating through the apology already. We ain't even opened the lid.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: That's my little brother. Same mama. Unfortunately, unlimited commentary.

speaker: All Jokes Roaster
text: I'm here for emotional support and whatever happens to his confidence.

speaker: Ganger Red
text: I paid the rent one month. Groceries when I could. I thought keeping things steady was helping.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: You let me think the whole block remembered him better than I did.

speaker: Ganger Red
text: I didn't know how to tell you.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: You open your mouth. You used it to ask what size diapers. It worked then.

speaker: All Jokes Roaster
text: Express shipping on the wipes. Four-year delay on the truth. Nasty warehouse operation.

speaker: Ganger Red
text: I was told leaving it alone was safer.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: By who?

speaker: Ganger Red
text: Someone I should have questioned. I need to speak to him first.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: You already gave him four years of first.

speaker: Church Auntie
text: Answer her, son. You can't cover a lie with a serving tray.

speaker: Ganger Red
text: Let me tell him I'm bringing you. He is going to hear this with you in the room.

speaker: Wifey
text: If you're promising that, don't make her collect it.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: After the final. We go together. The recorder stays with me.

speaker: Ganger Red
text: It stays with you. I should have brought it the first day.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: You should have brought it before there was a second.

speaker: All Jokes Roaster
text: Table four. I was supposed to roast the champion. Then my sister's past walked in wearing a haunted junk drawer.

speaker: Ganger Blue
text: Keep my brother out of—

speaker: All Jokes Roaster
text: Keep him? Y'all couldn't FIND him.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: You are not using my life as your comedy special.

speaker: All Jokes Roaster
text: I'm defending you.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: You printed tickets.

speaker: All Jokes Roaster
text: For the community to witness the defense.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: Play the match.

speaker: All Jokes Roaster
text: Fine. No mic. My deck still got something to say. Don't stack your whole ego in one district.

speaker: All Jokes Roaster
text: Fourth table cleared. You won a card game. Do not let Snitch caption it like you raised me.

speaker: Ganger Blue
text: You need a quiet place to process that? There's an empty VIP section by the door.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: You two done making a timeshare out of the last word?

speaker: All Jokes Roaster
text: I'm done. You need anything carried?

speaker: Baby Momma
text: The covered plates. To the volunteers. That's help.

speaker: All Jokes Roaster
text: Say less.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: That's what I've been trying to get you to do.

speaker: All Jokes Roaster
text: You had a plan. I could tell by how upset you got when it left. Run it back.

speaker: Ganger Blue
text: My wife don't play around.

speaker: Wifey
text: Your wife would like to play at all. Move the cooler.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: I got check-in. Sit down before somebody asks you to alphabetize the weather.

speaker: Wifey
text: Thank you. Table five. My name was on this list before Blue discovered electricity.

speaker: Ganger Blue
text: I was trying to compliment you.

speaker: Wifey
text: Then tell them my name without putting MY in front of it.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: Get her a chair with a back. That one requires an explanation.

speaker: Wifey
text: I've got one extra card in my opening hand. You'll see it in the briefing.

speaker: Wifey
text: And protection in this deck. Don't throw your biggest effect at the first thing that annoys you.

speaker: Ganger Blue
text: That's good life advice too.

speaker: Wifey
text: So is 'move the cooler.' We're all learning.

speaker: Wifey
text: Fifth table cleared. You kept your head. That's rarer than everybody's card collection.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: You played good. You should get to do that more.

speaker: Wifey
text: I should.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: You ever get tired of being the one everybody trusts to hold things together?

speaker: Wifey
text: Yeah.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: Then don't let them make you carry what's theirs.

speaker: Wifey
text: I'll try.

speaker: Ganger Blue
text: I moved the cooler.

speaker: Wifey
text: Good. Now take the applause you were expecting and use it to move the other one.

speaker: Wifey
text: You hit the protection and looked surprised it protected something. Take a breath.

speaker: Cracked Head
text: I brought a chair.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: Good. Put it with the others.

speaker: Cracked Head
text: You don't have to talk to me like I'm staff.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: Staff clock in.

speaker: Church Auntie
text: Leave that man a little air. He got stairs to go back down.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: I'm playing to run that showcase. Families get seats. Volunteers eat before the photographers.

speaker: Ganger Blue
text: That last rule feels personal.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: If the plate fits.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: You made it through five tables. Respect. Don't show up at mine expecting the same conversation.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: Round three, I pick up one extra Motion. Round five, Wifey joins my side as a reinforcement card.

speaker: Wifey
text: My card. Actual me is sitting down.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: Two phases. One match. Winner hosts. My family business stays mine either way.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: You won. Host the showcase. Keep the door open like you said.

speaker: Cornball
text: Can Liquid Gold submit a vendor application?

speaker: Baby Momma
text: The cheese is not getting a redemption arc.

speaker: Church Auntie
text: Give the winner a minute before y'all start asking for permits.

speaker: Cracked Head
text: You played like—

speaker: Baby Momma
text: Like me. I've been here the whole time.

speaker: Cracked Head
text: Yeah. You have.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: Red. You make that call?

speaker: Ganger Red
text: He knows we're coming.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: Then let's go. No more messages carried by men who keep the envelope.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: Take your time on the rematch. I don't need you panicking just because I got quiet.

speaker: Ganger Red
text: Showcase host confirmed. You kept the event standing while the rest of us tried to turn it into a group argument.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: Next one, the kids eat first. Put that somewhere Snitch can't crop.

speaker: Cornball
text: Liquid Gold respects the decision of the community.

speaker: Church Auntie
text: Then let the community bury that dispenser.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: Come with us. You've heard what was said. I'd like somebody there who isn't adding their own version.

speaker: OG Uncle
text: Red. I said call before you came.

speaker: Ganger Red
text: I did.

speaker: OG Uncle
text: You said company. This is a reckoning with a handbag.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: I brought something you've had four years to explain.

speaker: OG Uncle
text: Sit down.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: I'll sit when you answer. Did you tell Red not to give me this message?

speaker: OG Uncle
text: I told him to let you grieve.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: Over a man you knew was alive?

speaker: OG Uncle
text: Yes.

speaker: Baby Momma
text: Then who exactly were you protecting?
